I predetti titoli debbono essere coerenti con il corso prescelto.' Admission test: 'accertamento delle competenze musicali (storia della Musica Elettroacustica, Analisi d'ascolto, Teoria musicale), accertamento delle competenze in acustica e psicoacustica, informatica e tecnologie elettroacustiche, esame del curriculum di studi e/o artistico-professionale, e colloquio per verifica delle motivazioni e attività svolte.'

institution: Universitat Pompeu Fabra (UPF) — Music Technology Group, Department of Engineering

And on missing music training: 'if you do not have formal music education, thus covered in the CV, the motivation letter is a good place to explain your non-formal musical training.' Verdict: YES — computer science is named as the *ideal* background and a formal music degree is not required. This is the single strongest fit found in this sweep for a software-engineering BSc.
